note: Set A is preferred because it avoids duplicate claims and does not make incorrect engineering assertions about material properties, whereas Set B includes three pairs of duplicate claims and incorrectly identifies decking thickness as 1 1/2" (text specifies 3/4"). While Set A misbinds several dimensions to the wrong detail view (attributing B1 and A6 dimensions to C1 and B4 respectively), these are location errors rather than factual contradictions of the text. Set B demonstrates better semantic understanding of some B1 dimensions (identifying joist depth/width) but is marred by redundancy and the thickness error.
remarks: Both sets incorrectly identify the grid span for the 8'-0" dimension as 5-6 (visually 4-5). Set B's duplication of claims (First Flr, Bolt Length, Bolt Diameter) significantly reduces its quality. Set A's systematic misbinding of B1 dimensions to 'Decking Footing Plan' (C1) suggests a layout analysis error, but the values themselves are present on the page.
